messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: evening rollout scheduled 2024-06-02T02:00Z. Services: api:v2.5.0, runtime:v1.10.0, console:hotfix-2024-06-02, router:rolling-2024-06. Requesting explicit pin of runtime before api canary. Reply with :ok: to continue or :stop_sign: to abort.

nina (API): FYI api:v2.5.0 adds KV-cache header passthrough and changes streaming termination semantics. Requires runtime parser update (v1.10.0) or long polling requests will hang.

dev (runtime): confirmed. runtime v1.10.0 includes the caching key normalization and a fix for keep-alive rows. We'll need to avoid mixing old and new runtimes during canary traffic.

sam (router): router rolling-2024-06 has a new backpressure shim that alters request framing. We'll keep router at rolling-canary initially. Need a short replay to validate framing + streaming termination.

lee (console): console hotfix shows new cache keys in the UI. It's safe if api exposes the header as x-rw-cachekey. If we delay console, UX will show legacy keys for ~1h.

tara (release): proposed sequence: (A) promote runtime v1.10.0 to runtime-canary pool, wait 15m. (B) start api canary 2% to runtime-canary, 10m. (C) run framed-stream replay and synthetic long-poll smoke. (D) if green -> 20% then ramp. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > baseline+7% for 10m OR error rate +3% sustained for 5m.

sre-oncall: setting alert: api.requests.error_rate > baseline+0.03 for 5m -> pager. Also added a synthetic check to call /v2/stream with 60s idle.

dev (runtime): pin snippet for orchestration:
```yaml
pins:
  runtime: v1.10.0
  api: v2.5.0
  console: hotfix-2024-06-02
  router: rolling-canary-2024-06
```

tara (release): copy `/deploy hold --wave=late-night` into runbook. Also added rollback examples.

sam (router): starting 100-replay run vs api with runtime-canary. Will share diff results.

deploy-bot: Wave late-night scheduled. Canary routing: 2% to api:v2.5.0 -> runtime-canary.

nina (API): quick smoke locally: `curl -N -H "X-Cache-Key: foo" https://api.internal/v2/stream?idle=30` -> stream closes at end, headers intact.

[8m later]
sam (router): replay complete: framing parity 99.6%, no 5xx, minor header-name case differences (0.8%). Logs posted to #eng-telemetry.

tara (release): proceed with runtime canary rollout to 40% now.

sre-oncall: alerts armed. Monitoring synthetic long-poll.

[25m later]
deploy-bot: runtime canary at 40% pool. Ready for api 2% canary.

nina (API): starting api canary 2% (22:45 UTC). smoke: long poll + cache key test.

sre-oncall: initial window shows p95 +3%, error rate steady. No pager.

[12m later]
sre-oncall: anomaly detected: api.stream.disconnects spiked to 1.9% above baseline for 6m. Investigating traces to see component causing early termination.

dev (runtime): checking runtime logs. I see keep-alive reset when router sets connection:close in upgrade path.

sam (router): that was unexpected. There's a fallback path in rolling-canary that flips connection header on certain long requests. Rolling back that flag on canary now.

[immediate action]
tara (release): pause api canary ramp. Command: `/deploy hold --wave=late-night --reason="stream disconnect spike"`

deploy-bot: Hold applied. api canary frozen at 2%. Notifying teams.

lee (console): console UI unaffected but holding promote. We'll keep hotfix branch ready.

dev (runtime): rolling rollback of router flag works, runtime logs show fewer resets. Requesting a short retest before resuming.

sam (router): retest replay -> disconnects back to baseline. Patching scheduled to stable in next maintenance window.

[10m later]
sre-oncall: synthetic long-poll now stable. Error spike cleared.
tara (release): new plan: resume api canary but with smaller ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 15% with 15m windows. If any metric crosses thresholds, full rollback of api to v2.4.x.

nina (API): redeploying api:v2.5.0 canary at 23:10 UTC -> 1%.

[monitoring window]
sre-oncall: monitoring 45m. No sustained error or latency regressions. p95 within +4% during bursts only.

[final steps]
tara (release): promoted api to 60% over staged ramps. Runtime pin kept until 100% promote complete. Console hotfix promoted after api at 60%. Router patch queued for stable rollout.

sre-oncall: closing watch; documented the hold and root cause (router flag fallback) in the deployment notes.

deploy-bot: Wave complete. Summary: runtime v1.10.0 rolled, api v2.5.0 rolled with a brief hold due to router fallback flag. Actions: add an e2e test for long-poll framing, add a canary check for connection header behavior, schedule router stable rollout.

tara (release): thanks all. I'll update the release ticket and add follow-ups.

lee (console): :party-parrot: nice catch everyone.

-- end of thread --
